boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 93 arranges two purple chamber blocks in an L-shape — counter `13` in an orange frame on the left and counter `8` in an orange frame below. Red, blue, and yellow blocks are stacked to the right of the `13` chamber, with lock/key icons on the blue blocks. The surrounding blocks are sparse and clear in under 10 seconds, making the real challenge the 21 total passes needed across both chambers.
landmarks: Block Out Level 93 arranges two purple chamber blocks in an L-shape — counter `13` in an orange frame on the left and counter `8` in an orange frame below.
Red, blue, and yellow blocks are stacked to the right of the `13` chamber, with lock/key icons on the blue blocks.
The surrounding blocks are sparse and clear in under 10 seconds, making the real challenge the 21 total passes needed across both chambers.

quickTips: The surrounding blocks clear in under 10 seconds — spend planning time on keeping the `13` feed lane clear.
Clear the small green and cyan blocks between chambers before starting any feed.
Feed the `13` chamber first because it takes longer and benefits from maximum room.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Push the red blocks at the top-right through the top or right-wall exit to open the upper lane (02:26 in the video).

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the key blocks to unlock the blue blocks in the middle-right (02:23).

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Slide the unlocked blue blocks and yellow blocks through the right-wall exit to clear the right lane completely (02:20).

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the small green and cyan blocks between the two chambers through the nearest exits because they can drift into the feed path (02:17).

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Begin feeding the purple `13` chamber through the left-wall exit — thirteen passes, keeping the lane permanently clear (02:14–02:05).

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Sort any spilled blocks from the `13` chamber collapse before they reach the `8` chamber's zone (02:05).

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Feed the purple `8` chamber through the bottom exits — eight passes to finish (02:02–01:54).

failurePoints: Leaving the small green and cyan blocks between chambers during the `13` feed — they drift into the feeding lane and stall the counter mid-pass.
Starting with the `8` chamber — it sits below the `13` and benefits from the room created after the `13` collapses, not before.
